description:
Find genes with tissue-enriched or tissue-specific expression and save to CSV file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table expression_tissues — one record = one tissue's baseline expression of one gene.
Key: id, tissues[].efo_code.
Results: one row = one item (one tissue's baseline expression of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.tissue` counts tissues.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Tissues with a measurement for the gene; values of different units are not comparable.
The derived answer writes no CSV file; output_path is accepted and confined. Fold changes compare tissues in one unit only; genes expressed only in the target tissue have fold_change null and expressed_only_in_target true.
